name: What kind of utility connections do I need for a tiny home on my property?

mainEntity.name: What kind of utility connections do I need for a tiny home on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a fully functional tiny home, you'll typically need connections for electricity, water, and sewage. Electricity can be supplied via a standard hookup to the main grid, a dedicated sub-panel, or off-grid solutions like solar. Water can come from a municipal supply, a well, or a potable water storage tank. For sewage, options include connecting to a municipal sewer system, a septic tank, or composting toilets. The feasibility and cost of these connections depend on your property's existing infrastructure and local regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Utility connections for a tiny home typically include electricity, water, and sewage. Options range from municipal hookups to off-grid solutions like solar or septic systems, depending on your property and local rules.
